title: The Go For It Giveaway and the Reorder
lessons: The player encounters ZYN's 2026 Go For It Giveaway, which asked eligible adult nicotine consumers to submit a short video describing a dream adventure.
The player tries to reorder ZYN from ZYN.com and discovers the brand no longer sells product directly through its own online store.

text: The player encounters ZYN's 2026 Go For It Giveaway, which asked eligible adult nicotine consumers to submit a short video describing a dream adventure.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Wait. ZYN was offering people dream trips?

entry-first-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: During the 2026 contest period, eligible entrants could submit one portrait-format video, no longer than one minute, describing a desired adventure and how it would help them break from their everyday routine.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: And the prize?

entry-first-4.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Ten grand prizes, each with a maximum approximate retail value of fifteen thousand dollars, with the sponsor retaining discretion to interpret and fulfill the proposed adventure within the rules.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: You made "dream trip" sound like procurement.

entry-first-6.speaker: COUNSEL
text: There was also no purchase necessary, exclusions applied in Massachusetts, Michigan, and Virginia, and eligibility required legal-age nicotine-consumer status.

entry-first-7.speaker: PLAYER
text: Of course there was more.

entry-first-8.speaker: COUNSEL
text: There is always more.

choice-first.speaker: COUNSEL
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: Honestly, a brand funding someone's ridiculous dream trip is fun.
I would read the rights section before uploading my face and story.
I do not want my idea of adventure attached to a nicotine promotion.

first-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The promotion was explicitly designed around that appeal, subject to eligibility, verification, and prize limitations.

first-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Appropriate. The rules grant the sponsor broad rights to use, reproduce, edit, publish, and promote submitted entries.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: There is the lawyer I was expecting.

first-2-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: I have been present continuously.

first-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: No purchase was required, and no participation was required. Your adventure may remain non-sponsored.
The player tries to reorder ZYN from ZYN.com and discovers the brand no longer sells product directly through its own online store.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I am already logged in. Why can I not just buy it here?

entry-return-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Direct ZYN Store operations have been suspended. The site currently directs adult consumers to independent online retailers including Nicokick and Northerner, or to local retail distribution.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: So the official website tells me to leave the official website.

entry-return-4.speaker: COUNSEL
text: For purposes of product purchase, yes.

choice-return.speaker: COUNSEL
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: Fine. Just tell me where it is available.
That is a strange amount of friction for a brand this big.
If I have to chase it through another retailer, I will skip it.

return-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The current site is functioning as a routing layer rather than the seller of record.

return-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You found a way to make "store locator" sound litigious.

return-1-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Seller-of-record status is not decorative.

return-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The friction exists. Brand ownership does not guarantee direct-to-consumer fulfillment.

return-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Then the purchase does not occur. There is no contractual obligation to continue looking.
